articles.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
articles.snippet: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

articles.title: Bitcion tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
articles.snippet: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

articles.title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist?
articles.snippet: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
articles.snippet: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.

articles.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin swings to $126 million profit but misses revenue estimates
articles.snippet: Revenue fell to $63.4 million in the third quarter and missed analysts’ forecasts as bitcoin production declined and higher summer electricity prices pushed mining costs up.
